Dave Matthews Band
June 10, 2023
Xfinity Theatre
Hartford, CT




Taper: John Gortakowski
Location: Rear of GA PIT, Right Stack @ 12 ft
Source: akg/ck61 (cardioids)> nBob actives> > Edirol UA5 (Warm Mod) > Sony PCM-10, Analog input (@ 24/96kHz)
Transfer: PCM-10> USB> PC
Conversion: 24/96kHz wav->Sound Forge Pro 10> iZotope 64-Bit SRC & iZotope MBIT+ for resample and dither to 24/48kHz> 16/44.1 kHz, No normalization, Fade in fade out applied, Waves L3 Ultramaximizer applied->CD Wave Editor->Flac (level 8)> Foobar 2000 for tagging 

***************************************************************************************** 
*****************DO NOT ENCODE THIS SHOW TO LOSSY FORMATS******************************** 
*******************DO NOT SELL OR DISTRIBUTE FOR PROFIT**********************************
*****************************************************************************************
